_doc: The Tern's shield faces and presets (openspec/changes/weapons-and-shields section 9; coop-drill design 2.2). Faces in order: bow (+Z), stern (-Z), port (+X), starboard (-X), dorsal (+Y), ventral (-Y). Every preset sums to the 240 MJ capacity; each face is held to 15-80 MJ. Regeneration is 0.25 x the generator's 12 MW, shared by the preset's caps.
